```{r}
library(photobookr)

# First time only
photobookr_setup()

# Create config template
photobookr_example_config()

# Create chapters from markdown
markdown_to_chapters("book_text.md", body_size = 17, font_family = "helvetica")

# Build the book
build_book()

# Optionally build map
build_map()
```
